Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/942)
I shall be very glad that [the Rubies of St Lo](/book/234) should be published as you propose, I receiving [/4 per copy](/topic/160) sold. Thanks for the two school Lances of Lynwood.[^1] I am only just come home from Devon or I should have written sooner

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: [The Lances of Lynwood](/book/23) had just been brought out in an abridged edition for schools (London: Macmillan 1894)
